mainTopic: צירוף for a נזיר, and רבי אלעזר's list of ten רביעית measures
overview: The גמרא first finishes with רבי שמעון, who does not hold of צירוף. For him, the פסוק 'מכל אשר יעשה' teaches that a person is only a נזיר if he vows to keep away from everything a נזיר must avoid. Then רבי אלעזר rules that a permitted liquid joins a forbidden one to make a רביעית only for a נזיר, learned from the word 'משרת'. The גמרא explains how he differs from רבי יוחנן: רבי יוחנן includes even solid foods, while רבי אלעזר speaks only of liquids. Next, רבי אלעזר lists ten cases measured by a רביעית. רב כהנא remembers them with a memory hook of five red ones (wine and blood) and five white ones (oil, water and other liquids), and the גמרא explains each case. Finally, the גמרא challenges the count with more רביעית cases. It answers that disputed cases are not counted, and that the small מקוה is left out because the רבנן cancelled it.

steps.title: What does רבי שמעון learn from 'anything that is made'?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks what רבי שמעון learns from the פסוק 'מכל אשר יעשה', since he does not use it for צירוף.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי שמעון does not hold of combining. So what does he learn from the words 'anything that is made'?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks a question. The other view used the words 'מכל אשר יעשה' to teach צירוף, but רבי שמעון does not hold of צירוף, so what does he do with these words?
steps.deeperAnalysis: This question picks up from the earlier lines on the daf. The rule is that every word in the Torah must teach something. If רבי שמעון does not learn צירוף from this פסוק, the גמרא wants to know what he does learn from it.

keyTerms.meaning: Combining two things together to reach the minimum amount
'From anything that is made' (of the grapevine), a פסוק about the נזיר
What does he learn from it?

phrases.english: who does not hold of combining,
phrases.notes: This is רבי שמעון from just before. He holds you are liable for any amount, so he has no need for combining.

phrases.english: 'anything that is made',
what does he learn from it?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the earlier discussion of רבי שמעון's view on צירוף
steps.sheelahInformationSought: What רבי שמעון learns from 'מכל אשר יעשה' if not צירוף

steps.title: The פסוק teaches that a נזיר must accept all the prohibitions
steps.stepSummary: רבי שמעון uses the פסוק to teach that a person is not a נזיר unless he accepts all the prohibitions of נזירות.
steps.simpleTranslation: He could tell you: That פסוק is needed to teach that a person is never a נזיר until he vows to keep away from all of them.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that רבי שמעון uses the פסוק for a different lesson. It teaches that a vow of נזירות only works if it covers everything.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The word 'מכל' (from all) is read as 'all of it together.' So if someone vows to be a נזיר for only one part, like grapes but not wine, the vow does not take effect at all. This way the פסוק is still teaching something, even for רבי שמעון.

keyTerms.meaning: He could say to you (defending a view)
He needs it (for a different lesson)
That he vows נזירות from all of them

steps.whatToRemember: For רבי שמעון, 'מכל אשר יעשה' does not teach צירוף. It teaches that a נזיר vow must include all the prohibitions.

phrases.english: He could say to you:
That is needed by him for:
one is never a nazir
until he vows to keep away from all of them.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of step 1
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The פסוק teaches that one is only a נזיר if he vows from all the prohibitions

steps.title: Permitted joins forbidden only for a נזיר's רביעית
steps.stepSummary: רבי אלעזר rules that for every רביעית in the Torah, a permitted liquid does not join a forbidden one, except for a נזיר, because of the word 'משרת'.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אבהו said in the name of רבי אלעזר: For every quarter-log measure in the Torah, a permitted thing does not combine with a forbidden thing, except for the quarter-log of a נזיר, because the Torah said 'soaked.'
steps.whatsHappening: רבי אלעזר gives a new rule. Normally a permitted liquid cannot help a forbidden liquid reach the amount of a רביעית, but for a נזיר it can.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The Torah forbids a נזיר anything 'משרת', meaning grapes soaked in liquid. Even when the wine taste is mixed into another liquid, it still counts. So for a נזיר, wine mixed with a permitted liquid adds up to a רביעית.

keyTerms.meaning: A quarter of a לוג, a standard liquid measure
A permitted thing combining with a forbidden thing
Soaking (liquid in which grapes were soaked)

phrases.aramaic: אָמַר רַבִּי אֲבָהוּ אָמַר רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר:
phrases.english: Rabbi Abbahu said that Rabbi Elazar said:
all the quarter-log measures in the Torah,
a permitted thing does not combine with a forbidden thing,
except for the quarter-log of a nazir,
since the Torah said 'soaked.'

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַבִּי אֲבָהוּ אָמַר רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Brings a new statement about צירוף for a נזיר
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Permitted joins forbidden to make a רביעית only for a נזיר, learned from 'משרת'

steps.title: How is רבי אלעזר different from רבי יוחנן?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks what the difference is between רבי אלעזר's rule and רבי יוחנן's earlier rule, which sounds the same.
steps.simpleTranslation: What is the difference between רבי יוחנן and רבי אלעזר?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא notices that רבי יוחנן already said that permitted joins forbidden only for a נזיר. It asks how רבי אלעזר's rule is any different, and the next step answers.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If two אמוראים say the same thing, the גמרא wants to know if they really agree or if there is a hidden difference. This question sets up the answer that their rules cover different things.

phrases.english: What is there between
Rabbi Yoḥanan and Rabbi Elazar?
phrases.notes: רבי יוחנן said this earlier on 35b: permitted joins forbidden only for a נזיר.

steps.triggerLanguage: מַאי אִיכָּא בֵּין רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן לְרַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Compares רבי אלעזר's rule from step 3 with רבי יוחנן's earlier rule
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The practical difference between רבי יוחנן and רבי אלעזר

steps.title: רבי יוחנן includes foods; רבי אלעזר only liquids
steps.stepSummary: The difference is that רבי יוחנן applies the rule even to foods, while רבי אלעזר applies it only to liquids.
steps.simpleTranslation: There is a difference between them. רבי יוחנן includes even foods. רבי אלעזר says: liquids, yes; other things, no.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the two rules are not the same. They disagree about solid foods.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For רבי יוחנן, a נזיר who eats bread with grapes can be liable if together they reach an olive's size. For רבי אלעזר, only liquids join together, because his rule is about a רביעית, which measures liquids, and 'משרת' is about liquid.

keyTerms.meaning: There is a difference between them

steps.whatToRemember: רבי יוחנן: permitted joins forbidden for a נזיר even for foods. רבי אלעזר: only for liquids.

phrases.english: There is a difference between them,
as Rabbi Yoḥanan includes even foods,
and Rabbi Elazar: liquids, yes,
other things, no.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of step 4
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: רבי יוחנן includes foods; רבי אלעזר limits the rule to liquids

steps.title: Ten quarter-log cases and a memory hook
steps.stepSummary: Since the topic is a רביעית, the גמרא brings רבי אלעזר's teaching that there are ten cases of a רביעית, with רב כהנא's memory hook of five red and five white.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אלעזר said: There are ten quarter-log cases. רב כהנא held in his hand a memory hook: five red and five white.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא moves to a related topic. It brings a list of ten places in halacha where a רביעית is the measure, which will be explained next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This is not part of the argument before. It is a side teaching brought because the word רביעית just came up. The 'red' and 'white' groups help a learner remember the ten cases.

keyTerms.meaning: Ten cases of the quarter-log measure
Held in his hand (had a way to remember)

phrases.english: Rabbi Elazar said:
There are ten quarter-logs,
and Rav Kahana held in his hand
phrases.notes: He means רב כהנא had a memory hook to keep the list straight.

phrases.english: five red and five white.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר: עֶשֶׂר רְבִיעִיּוֹת הֵן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: A side topic brought because the word רביעית came up in step 3
steps.mimraCoreRuling: There are ten halachic cases measured by a רביעית: five red and five white

steps.title: The memory hook for the five red cases
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא gives the memory words for the five red cases: נזיר, עושה פסח, הורו, במקדש, ומתו.
steps.simpleTranslation: The five red ones: 'A נזיר, and one who does the פסח, who taught, in the מקדש, and they died.'
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא starts to fill in the list. It gives a short phrase whose words remind us of the five red cases, which will be explained next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The red cases are the ones about wine or blood. Each word in the phrase points to one case, like the נזיר's רביעית of wine. The explanation of each case comes in the next lines.

keyTerms.meaning: One who does the קרבן פסח (and its seder)

phrases.english: The five red ones:
'A nazir, and one who performs the Pesach,
who taught, in the Temple, and they died.'
phrases.notes: These are just memory words, one for each case. The גמרא explains each one right after this.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Fills in the first half of the list from step 6
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The five red רביעית cases are remembered by: נזיר, עושה פסח, הורו, במקדש, ומתו

steps.title: Red case one: a נזיר's wine
steps.stepSummary: The memory word נזיר stands for the רביעית of wine that a נזיר is forbidden to drink.
steps.simpleTranslation: 'נזיר': a quarter-log of wine for a נזיר.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא starts explaining the red memory words one at a time. The first word, נזיר, points to the amount of wine a נזיר is punished for drinking.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Each memory word from step 7 is a short tag for a full halacha. Here the tag נזיר means a נזיר becomes liable once he drinks a רביעית of wine. Wine is red, so it belongs to the red group.

keyTerms.meaning: A person who took a vow to keep away from wine and grape products
A memory hook, a word that helps you remember a list

phrases.english: "Nazir": a quarter-log of wine for a nazir.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Begins explaining the red memory words listed in step 7.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A נזיר is liable for drinking a רביעית of wine.

steps.title: Red case two: the four cups at the פסח seder
steps.stepSummary: The memory word עושה פסח refers to שמואל's rule that each of the four cups must hold a רביעית.
steps.simpleTranslation: 'One who performs the פסח': as רב יהודה said in the name of שמואל, these four cups must each hold at least a quarter-log.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains the second red word. It means the four cups of wine at the seder each need to hold a רביעית.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The גמרא backs up this case by quoting רב יהודה in the name of שמואל. The cups are wine, so this is a red case.

keyTerms.meaning: One who performs the פסח ritual (the seder night)
The four cups of wine drunk at the seder
רב יהודה reporting a teaching of his teacher שמואל

phrases.english: "One who performs the Pesach":
as Rav Yehuda said in the name of Shmuel:
these four cups
must contain the amount of a quarter-log.

steps.triggerLanguage: עושה פסח דאמר רב יהודה אמר שמואל
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Second red memory word explained.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Each of the four cups at the seder must contain a רביעית.

steps.title: Red case three: no rulings after drinking wine
steps.stepSummary: The memory word שהורו means that someone who drank a רביעית of wine should not give halachic rulings.
steps.simpleTranslation: 'Who ruled': one who drank a quarter-log of wine should not give rulings.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains the third red word. After drinking a רביעית of wine, a person should not decide halacha for others.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Here a רביעית of wine is the point at which a person is no longer fit to give rulings. Again it is wine, so it is red.

keyTerms.meaning: He should not give a ruling

phrases.english: "Who ruled":
one who drank a quarter-log of wine should not give a ruling.

steps.triggerLanguage: שהורו שתה רביעית יין אל יורה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Third red memory word explained.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: One who drank a רביעית of wine may not give halachic rulings.

steps.title: Red case four: entering the Temple after wine
steps.stepSummary: The memory word במקדש means that one who drank a רביעית of wine and entered the מקדש is liable to death.
steps.simpleTranslation: 'In the Temple': one who drank a quarter-log of wine and entered the Temple is liable to death.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains the fourth red word. Entering the מקדש after a רביעית of wine carries a death penalty.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This is the most serious of the wine cases: the same amount of wine that stops a person from ruling also makes entering the מקדש punishable by death from heaven.

phrases.english: "In the Temple":
one who drank a quarter-log of wine and entered the Temple
is liable to death.

steps.triggerLanguage: במקדש שתה רביעית יין ונכנס למקדש חייב מיתה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Fourth red memory word explained.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Entering the מקדש after drinking a רביעית of wine makes one liable to death.

steps.title: Red case five: a quarter-log of blood from two dead people
steps.stepSummary: The memory word ומתו refers to a ברייתא: a רביעית of blood from two dead people makes things impure in a tent, learned from the plural word נפשות.
steps.simpleTranslation: 'And they died': as was taught, from where do we know that a quarter-log of blood that comes out of two dead people makes things impure in a tent? Because it says, 'He shall not come near any dead bodies.'
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains the last red word. It is blood, not wine, and the case is a רביעית of blood that comes from two dead people together.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Even though each person gave only part of the רביעית, the two amounts join to make the tent impure. The source is the פסוק's plural word נפשות, meaning more than one dead person. Blood is red, which is why this case closes the red group.

keyTerms.meaning: Makes impure everything under the same roof
Literally 'souls'; here it means dead bodies, in the plural

steps.whatToRemember: The five red cases are four about wine (נזיר, the four cups, ruling, the מקדש) and one about blood (two dead people).

phrases.english: "And they died": as it was taught:
from where do we know that a quarter-log of blood
that comes out of two dead people
makes things impure in a tent?

phrases.aramaic: שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וְעַל כׇּל נַפְשׁוֹת מֵת לֹא יָבֹא״.
phrases.english: As it says: "He shall not come near any dead bodies."
phrases.notes: ויקרא 21:11. The word נפשות is plural, which hints that blood from two people joins together.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Fifth and last red memory word; ends the red list.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A רביעית of blood from two dead people joins together to make things impure in a tent, learned from נפשות.

steps.title: The memory words for the five white cases
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא gives the memory phrase for the five white cases: חלת, נזיר, ומצורע, שנפסלו, בשבת.
steps.simpleTranslation: And the five white ones: 'The loaf of, a נזיר, and a מצורע, which were disqualified, on שבת.'
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא now turns to the white group and first gives its memory phrase. This sets up the explanations that come next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Just as the red list had its own memory words, the white list gets one too. The white cases involve oil, water and other liquids, not wine or blood.

keyTerms.meaning: A person with the skin disease צרעת

phrases.english: And the five white ones:
"The loaf of, a nazir, and a leper,
which were disqualified, on Shabbat."
phrases.notes: These words aren't one sentence. Each one is a separate tag, explained one by one next.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves from the red list to the white list mentioned in step 6.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The white cases are remembered by: חלת, נזיר, מצורע, שנפסלו, בשבת.

steps.title: White cases one to three: oil for loaves, oil for a נזיר, water for a מצורע
steps.stepSummary: חלת means a רביעית of oil for the loaves, נזיר means a רביעית of oil for a נזיר, and מצורע means a רביעית of water for a מצורע.
steps.simpleTranslation: 'The loaf': a quarter-log of oil for the loaf. 'נזיר': a quarter-log of oil for a נזיר. 'מצורע': a quarter-log of water for a מצורע.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains the first three white words quickly, one line each.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Oil and water are clear or light-colored, so they belong to the white group. Notice that נזיר shows up in both lists: red for his forbidden wine, white for the oil used with his offering.

keyTerms.meaning: A loaf brought with an offering

steps.confusionAlert: נזיר appears in both lists. In the red list it is the wine he may not drink; in the white list it is the oil for his offering's loaves.

phrases.english: "The loaf": a quarter-log of oil for the loaf.
phrases.notes: These are the loaves brought with a תודה offering.

phrases.english: "Nazir": a quarter-log of oil for a nazir.
"Leper": a quarter-log of water for a leper.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Explains the first three white memory words.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The loaves and the נזיר each use a רביעית of oil; the מצורע uses a רביעית of water.

steps.title: White case four: impure liquids make the body unfit
steps.stepSummary: שנפסלו refers to a משנה: drinking a רביעית of impure liquids makes the body unfit.
steps.simpleTranslation: 'Which were disqualified': as we learned in a משנה, all other impure liquids make the body unfit at a quarter-log.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains the fourth white word by quoting a משנה about drinking impure liquids.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Someone who drinks a רביעית of impure liquid has his body made unfit, so he can't eat holy food like תרומה. The source is a משנה, marked by דתנן.

keyTerms.meaning: As we learned in a משנה

phrases.english: "Which were disqualified": as we learned in a mishna:
and all other impure liquids
make the body unfit at a quarter-log.
phrases.notes: He means the person who drinks it can't eat תרומה.

steps.triggerLanguage: שנפסלו דתנן ושאר כל המשקין טמאין
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Fourth white memory word explained.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Drinking a רביעית of impure liquids makes the body unfit.

steps.title: White case five: carrying liquids on Shabbat
steps.stepSummary: בשבת refers to a משנה: carrying a רביעית of other liquids or waste water on שבת makes one liable.
steps.simpleTranslation: 'On שבת': as we learned in a משנה, all other liquids are at a quarter-log, and all waste water is at a quarter-log.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains the last white word, finishing the list of ten. On שבת, carrying a רביעית of these liquids from one domain to another makes a person liable.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה sets the amount for carrying liquids on שבת. For other liquids and for waste water, the amount is a רביעית. This completes the ten cases of a רביעית that רבי אלעזר counted.

keyTerms.meaning: Carrying from one domain to another on שבת

steps.whatToRemember: The ten cases of a רביעית: red (נזיר's wine, four cups, ruling, the מקדש, blood of two dead people) and white (oil for loaves, oil for a נזיר, water for a מצורע, impure liquids, carrying liquids on שבת).

phrases.english: "On Shabbat": as we learned in a mishna:
and all other liquids are at a quarter-log,
and all waste water is at a quarter-log.

steps.triggerLanguage: בשבת דתנן ושאר כל המשקין ברביעית
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Fifth and last white memory word; completes the ten cases.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: On שבת, carrying a רביעית of other liquids or waste water makes one liable.

steps.title: Challenge: what about washing hands with a quarter-log?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks whether the list of ten is complete, pointing to the משנה that a רביעית of water is enough for washing hands, even for two people.
steps.simpleTranslation: Are there no more cases? But there is the rule that from a quarter-log of water one may wash the hands of one person, and even of two.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges the list of ten by bringing an eleventh case that also uses a רביעית: נטילת ידים.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The list claimed exactly ten cases measured by a רביעית. The משנה about washing hands also uses a רביעית, so the count looks wrong. Either the list is missing a case, or there must be a reason it was left out.

keyTerms.meaning: And are there no more? (a challenge to a list)
Washing the hands before eating bread
A quarter of a לוג, a set measure of liquid

phrases.english: And are there no more?
But there is:
From a quarter-log one washes the hands
for one person, and even for two.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges רבי אלעזר's count of exactly ten (step 6), whose red and white cases were spelled out in steps 7-16.
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that there are exactly ten רביעית cases.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Brings another case that uses a רביעית but is not on the list.

steps.title: Answer: the list leaves out disputed cases
steps.stepSummary: The list only counts cases everyone agrees on, and the washing-hands rule is disputed.
steps.simpleTranslation: The list does not deal with cases that are in dispute.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the list only includes rules everyone agrees on, so a disputed case does not count.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Some disagree that one רביעית can serve two people. Since the רביעית here is not agreed on by all, it was not counted. The list stays at ten.

keyTerms.meaning: It does not deal with disputed cases

phrases.english: It does not deal with a dispute.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of step 17.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Limits the scope of the list to undisputed cases.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Every case measured by a רביעית should be on the list.
steps.terutzMaskana: Only undisputed רביעית cases are counted, so the washing-hands case is left out.

steps.title: Challenge: what about the water for a סוטה?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא brings the case of the water for a סוטה, where רבי יהודה says a רביעית was used.
steps.simpleTranslation: But there is the case where the כהן would bring an earthenware cup and put half a log of water from the basin into it, and רבי יהודה says a quarter-log.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings another possible case missing from the list: the water used for a סוטה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The first opinion says half a לוג, but רבי יהודה says a רביעית. According to רבי יהודה, this would be another רביעית case missing from the list.

keyTerms.meaning: The washing basin in the בית המקדש

phrases.english: But there is:
he would bring an earthenware cup
phrases.notes: "He" is the כהן preparing the special water for a סוטה.

phrases.aramaic: וְנוֹתֵן לְתוֹכָהּ חֲצִי לוֹג מַיִם מִן הַכִּיּוֹר,
phrases.english: and put into it half a log of water from the basin,
and Rabbi Yehuda says: a quarter-log.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: A second counter-example to the list of ten.
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that there are exactly ten רביעית cases.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: According to רבי יהודה the סוטה water is a רביעית, so it should be on the list.

steps.title: Same answer: the סוטה case is disputed
steps.stepSummary: The סוטה case is also a מחלוקת, so the list leaves it out.
steps.simpleTranslation: The list does not deal with cases that are in dispute.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא gives the same answer: this case is disputed, so it is not counted.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The רביעית here is only רבי יהודה's view, against the first opinion of half a לוג. A case that depends on one side of a מחלוקת does not make the list.

keyTerms.meaning: A woman suspected by her husband, who drinks the special water

phrases.english: It does not deal with a dispute.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 19 using the rule from step 18.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Same scope limit: disputed cases are not listed.
steps.terutzMaskana: Since it is only one side of a מחלוקת, it is left out.

steps.title: Challenge: what about water poured into urine?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא brings the case of how much water must be put into urine before praying, where רבי זכאי says a רביעית.
steps.simpleTranslation: But there is: how much water must one put into it? Any amount. רבי זכאי says: a quarter-log.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a third possible missing case, about water poured into urine.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The first opinion says any amount of water is enough. רבי זכאי says a רביעית is needed, which would add another case to the list.

keyTerms.meaning: A תנא who requires a רביעית here

phrases.english: But there is:
how much water does one put into it?
phrases.notes: "It" is a container of urine. Water is added so a person may pray nearby.

phrases.english: any amount,
Rabbi Zakkai says: a quarter-log!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: A third counter-example to the list.
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that there are exactly ten רביעית cases.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: According to רבי זכאי this case uses a רביעית, so it seems missing.

steps.title: Same answer: the urine case is disputed
steps.stepSummary: This case is also a מחלוקת, so it is left off the list.
steps.simpleTranslation: The list does not deal with cases that are in dispute.
steps.whatsHappening: Again the גמרא answers that disputed cases are not counted.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Only רבי זכאי requires a רביעית; the first opinion says any amount works. So it is left out, just like the last two cases.

phrases.english: It does not deal with a dispute.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 21 with the same rule.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Same scope limit: disputed cases are not listed.
steps.terutzMaskana: It is only one side of a מחלוקת, so it is left out.

steps.title: Challenge: what about a tiny מקוה?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא brings the case of a מקוה of a רביעית, used for very small vessels.
steps.simpleTranslation: But there is the case of a מקוה!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a fourth possible missing case: a מקוה of a רביעית.
steps.deeperAnalysis: There is a law that very small vessels can be dipped in a רביעית of water. This case is not a מחלוקת, so the earlier answer does not work here.

keyTerms.meaning: A ritual bath for removing טומאה

phrases.english: But there is the case of a ritual bath!
phrases.notes: This refers to the rule that very small vessels, like needles, could be dipped in just a רביעית of water.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: A fourth counter-example, this time one that is not a מחלוקת.
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that there are exactly ten רביעית cases.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Brings an undisputed רביעית case, so the earlier answer cannot be used.

steps.title: Answer: the רבנן cancelled the small מקוה
steps.stepSummary: The מקוה case is left out because the רבנן cancelled that law.
steps.simpleTranslation: Except for that one, because the רבנן cancelled it.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers with a new reason: the small מקוה is not counted because the רבנן cancelled it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Here the earlier answer about a מחלוקת does not apply, so a different reason is needed. The רבנן ruled that even small vessels need a full מקוה of forty סאה, so the רביעית מקוה is no longer in force. The list stays at ten.

keyTerms.meaning: Forty סאה, the normal size of a kosher מקוה

steps.whatToRemember: The list of ten רביעית cases holds up: it leaves out cases that are a מחלוקת (washing hands, the סוטה water, the urine case), and it leaves out the small מקוה because the רבנן cancelled it.

phrases.english: Except for that one,
because the Sages cancelled it.
phrases.notes: The רבנן required a full-sized מקוה even for tiny vessels.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 23 with a new reason, since the מחלוקת answer did not fit.
steps.terutzResolutionType: The law was cancelled, so it is not counted.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The small מקוה is an undisputed רביעית case and should be on the list.
steps.terutzMaskana: The רבנן cancelled it, so it is not part of the list.
